title: Entropic Scalar EFT: From Entanglement Microstructure to Gravity and Cosmic Structure
summary: We propose that empty space is a physical medium with a finite budget of quantum entanglement: the linking structure that allows parts of a quantum system to share state. Matter forms when some of that capacity becomes locked into stable, localized defects of the medium. A particle's mass measures how much entanglement is committed to such a defect. Gravity is the surrounding capacity-strain field: near matter, slightly less entanglement capacity is freely available, and in the weak-field limit the fractional shortfall gives the gravitational potential.
